title: harden approval workflow governance (audit + status guard + idempotency/concurrency)
constraints: no weakening of owner approval semantics
no schema change / no production migration
real Postgres DB proof (no Prisma mocks); real fail-before/pass-after

gates.note: maintained suite step 15 success on postgres:16
prior MVP Readiness Validation next-build OOM flake did not recur

rows.model_facts: no version/updatedAt/workspaceId column; @@unique([operatorItemId, approverUserId]); workspace via operatorItem

rows.defect: no audit event on any mutation of a >$100k governed approval surface
unconditional update -> an already-approved request can be silently flipped to rejected (and vice-versa)
read-then-write TOCTOU; repeated approve re-stamps approvedAt; concurrent approve+reject can double-apply

changes: add resolveApprovalWorkspaceId helper (derive audit workspaceId via operatorItem)
requestApproval: create + APPROVAL_REQUESTED audit in one $transaction (fail-closed); keep unique-key idempotency
approveOutcome: status-guarded updateMany CAS(status=pending)->approved + APPROVAL_GRANTED in tx; idempotent replay; blocks flip of terminal records
rejectOutcome: status-guarded updateMany CAS(status=pending)->rejected + APPROVAL_DENIED in tx; blocks approved->rejected flip; idempotent
authorization (approverUserId check) preserved; no schema change

cases: requestApproval idempotent (no dup row, no 2nd audit)
approved cannot be silently flipped to rejected (guard)
rejected cannot be silently flipped to approved (guard)
repeated approve idempotent (no re-stamp, single grant audit)
unauthorized actor cannot approve/reject (no mutation, no audit)
invalid transition returns controlled result, no raw 500
concurrent approve+reject: exactly one wins + exactly one transition audit (CAS)

rows.method: temporarily reverted approveOutcome to the pre-fix unconditional update (no audit, no guard)
rows.result: 4 tests failed: APPROVAL_GRANTED audit, rejected->approved guard, idempotent replay, concurrency CAS

rows.expectation: required gates green; [db] approval tests run in build-and-test (real postgres:16); Security Baseline HONEST_GREEN

items: no optimistic-lock/version column on ApprovalRequest (CAS suffices; version column deferred as it needs a migration)
transition primitives have no dedicated HTTP route wrapper (route-level auth = Phase 6E)
owner-mode approval path (resolveOwnerApproval) out of scope

confirmed_high_added_to_queue: invite boolean privilege escalation: active non-admin can invite members and assign roles (src/app/api/onboarding/invite/route.ts:50) -> Phase 6E

next_recommended_phase: Phase 6E — workspace enforcement + invite-boolean privilege fix + withAuth migration
